base:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production wallpaper master panorama for Poly World Alpine, to later animate as a layered 2.5D desktop environment.
Generate a spectacular, beautifully art-directed ultra-wide 3:1 landscape illustration, target 3840x1280 pixels, highest available detail and sharpness. ONE continuous coherent alpine valley seen by a horizontally travelling camera, constant eye level, common horizon, perspective and sunset illumination. No panels or triptych divisions.
LEFT THIRD: open tranquil turquoise alpine lake, distant angular peaks, sunlit far shoreline, breathing space. MIDDLE THIRD: forested lakeshore with layered evergreen pines, one small warmly lit timber cabin and a little wooden jetty, water visible in lower half. RIGHT THIRD: lake shoreline gradually rises into a rugged walkable mountain pass with faceted slate rocks, alpine grass and misty mountain ridges. These are connected locations in the same valley, not separate scenes. Each third should also be a beautiful wallpaper viewport; transitional overlap zones feel natural. Upper 30 percent airy pale peach to muted blue sky, no dramatic sun disk, no clouds (clouds will be animated as separate assets). Far mountains desaturated and atmospheric, craggy detailed geometry, subtly snow-tipped.
Art direction: refined high-detail LOW POLY / STYLIZED ART, sculptural angular rock facets and polygonal tree crowns, professional game-environment matte painting with believable spatial depth and excellent lighting, not photographic, not plastic toy 3D, not simplistic flat icons. Sage and deep evergreen forest, slate-blue distant mountains, teal water, delicate golden sunset rim light and peach atmosphere. Elegant calm usable desktop background.
Animation-aware design: calm unbroken water areas with clear shoreline and reflection boundaries suitable for later masked ripple distortion; cabin chimney present but NO baked smoke; clean open sky suitable for separately composited drifting clouds; layered middle-distance conifer silhouettes, no massive close foreground objects covering the scene because these will be another parallax layer. All lighting and water still-image only; no motion blur or baked streak effects.
Constraints: landscape reaches all four edges; NO text, NO UI, NO borders, NO logos, NO watermark, NO people. This is final standalone artwork, not a presentation board.

layers.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent animated-cloud overlay for the supplied Alpine panorama. Input image is STYLE AND LIGHTING REFERENCE ONLY; do not reproduce its mountains, trees, land, water, cabin or sky background. Generate only a sparse elegant cluster of separate sunset cloud wisps on a truly transparent RGBA background, ultra-wide 3:1 composition matching the reference's canvas aspect. Soft low-poly stylized cloud forms with subtly angular planes, pale warm peach sunlit edges on the left, desaturated lavender-blue shadows, delicate feathered semi-transparent edges. Clouds distributed across upper 55% with ample transparent gaps, lower 45% entirely transparent. A few long thin graceful cloud banks, no storm clouds or cotton balls. Keep all cloud shapes comfortably inside canvas so no hard clipped ends. Intended to drift slowly over a peach alpine sky, restrained and natural. No scenery, no sky fill, no horizon, no rectangular background, no text, no checkerboard painted into the image. Highest detail, matching refined game environment illustration style.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: foreground parallax overlay for the supplied Alpine panorama. Input image is STYLE, LIGHTING, CAMERA AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate an ultra-wide 3:1 genuinely transparent RGBA illustration containing ONLY a sparse near-camera alpine foreground along the bottom edge and outermost corners: finely sculpted angular slate rocks with muted moss, small tufts of alpine grass, and a few dark evergreen pine branches entering at the extreme left and right. Sunset warm golden rim light from the LEFT, deep forest-green shadows, the same detailed low-poly stylized art style as reference. The middle 75 percent of image width must remain unobstructed above the lowest 10 percent so the lake and cabin are fully visible; corners may reach 30 percent image height but no more. Upper 65 percent completely transparent. Foreground is arranged as irregular shore fragments, NOT a solid horizontal bar. Small crisp attractive details, readable natural silhouettes, genuine alpha transparency between branches and grass. NO sky, NO lake, NO mountains, NO cabin, NO background forest, NO text, NO interface, NO frame, NO checkerboard painted into image. This will translate slightly faster than the base panorama for depth.
